C-BACKGROUND-ASSISTANT-368.Summary: Finish optional background assistance for documents, dates, deadlines and report-source fields without delaying deterministic work.
C-BACKGROUND-ASSISTANT-368.Problem: The document worker awaits Qwen before persisting assignments; independent callers compete for a single CPU model slot. Expired running jobs are not reclaimed. Operators lack actionable, source-checked background findings and reversible field assistance at report sources.

Goals.Goal: Persist deterministic document objects and projections before durable optional enrichment. Keep intake running while the model is busy or unavailable.
Serialize application model calls through a bounded SQLite-backed lane with cancellation, lease ownership and recovery. Preserve current search authorization and exact quotations.
Analyze active deadlines, inconsistent dates and available materials using deterministic rules; show stable, actionable findings in the existing review/workflow surfaces.

Offer source-backed suggestions for scientific report metadata at the canonical scientific item, with explicit application, optimistic concurrency, preserved provenance and undo. Reports continue to project canonical items.

Constraints.Constraint: Authority: user request and issue 368, continuing 88 and 366. Exact main: 6e3f1e9f3870be47d4cd7386d792361b3cc415b1.

Keep SQLite schema 31 and all applied migrations unchanged. Reuse jobs, review_items, existing domain services and append-only audit records. No new installer, runtime dependency, cloud, CDN or mandatory LLM.
Source blobs, hashes, versions, extracted facts and historical evidence remain unchanged. No model tools may complete tasks, reschedule, delete, change access or silently overwrite manual work.
Dates are validated and compared in the configured workspace deployment timezone; a model suggestion is not a confirmed business fact. A discussion of publication is not evidence of publication.
Use canonical authorization before computation, before returning suggestions and again before applying or undoing. Queue input and output budgets are bounded; one failed item does not block others.
Use the existing design and canonical navigation, without a new dashboard or chat. No-motion. No formal agent execution is claimed without an actual invocation.
No release or version bump. Project CI owns unit/integration and smoke; GRACE owns scope/lint and the storage recovery gate. Targeted browser verification must cover the actual changed UI.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Autonomous signing, sending, approval, completion, destructive actions, free-form rewriting of whole official reports or changing ACL policy.
Claim real Qwen performance or physical Astra acceptance from synthetic HTTP fixtures.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: With a delayed or unreachable model, a directive, its assignments and search fragments are available before enrichment completes; another document is processed independently.
Running jobs recover after lease expiry; stale owners cannot heartbeat, complete or overwrite a reassigned job. Concurrent model users respect the single-slot lane and finite waiting budget.

Analysis distinguishes approaching, due-today, overdue, malformed and contradictory dates. Terminal and archived objects do not generate active deadline findings; repeated sweeps do not duplicate unchanged or dismissed findings.
Findings open the canonical task, meeting, plan or material. Related materials remain optional and do not change task status or prove publication merely by topic similarity.

Scientific report metadata suggestions name an allowed field, current source version, locator and verified quotation. Explicit apply updates the canonical item; source or target changes reject stale proposals. Undo cannot overwrite later manual changes.
Disabled LLM, empty evidence, invalid output, timeout, cancellation, partial success, restart, workspace separation and access revocation are covered by regression tests.
Relevant exact-head CI, storage recovery and targeted desktop/mobile browser checks pass before merge; installed-Qwen acceptance remains explicitly separate.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head project CI, existing GRACE database recovery gate and scoped browser checks. Synthetic model tests are labeled as such.
